scope: R14 final local verification for approved existing contracts and explicit classification of remaining product-contract blockers

currentStatus.meaning: All currently approved and feasible R14 engineering items are locally verified. R14 is not DONE or release-ready because product, provider, scale, manual and remote gates remain open.

csvNullVsEmpty.currentBehavior: Lossy: SQL NULL and empty string serialize to the same empty CSV cell.
evidence: client/src/core/utils/csv.ts:2 maps null and undefined to an empty cell
client/src/core/utils/csv.ts:20 imports absent cells with defval empty string
csvNullVsEmpty.reason: The CSV bytes contain no reversible distinction. A sentinel, schema sidecar or column-aware import policy must be approved.

mongoTypedMutation.currentBehavior: Contained for row update/delete: non-SQL typed row editing is rejected before strategy dispatch. Generic JSON insert and MQL mutation remain available without a BSON subtype-preserving guarantee.
evidence: server/src/query/query.service.ts:1068-1088 rejects non-SQL row editing before strategy dispatch
server/src/query/dto/update-row.dto.ts defines JSON values but no Extended JSON or BSON subtype envelope
mongoTypedMutation.reason: Enabling typed ObjectId, Decimal128, Binary or other BSON identities and writes would invent a public wire contract.

redisWritesAndPaging.currentBehavior: Redis insert remains reachable and uses SET, so an existing key type or TTL can be replaced. Row update/delete are blocked by typed-identity containment.
evidence: server/src/database-strategies/redis.strategy.ts:205-232 uses SET for update and insert
server/src/database-strategies/redis.strategy.ts:504-531 implements bounded SCAN without snapshot isolation
redisWritesAndPaging.reason: Overwrite, missing-key, accepted type conversion and TTL-copy behavior are undefined; SCAN cannot promise stable offset pages during concurrent mutation.

migrationResume.currentBehavior: Contained: replay after streaming begins is rejected; already committed partial rows are not rolled back.
evidence: server/src/migration/migration.service.ts:423-501 records acknowledged partial batches and fails on partial acknowledgement
migrationResume.reason: There is no persisted checkpoint, idempotency key or whole-transfer rollback contract after an ambiguous partial commit.
